text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One weekend, Shinko Windy takes<n>me to the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Crocodiles! Hippos! Gorillas! Let's<n>go, let's go! We
have so much to<n>see!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Those guys really know how to bite!<n>We definitely
can't miss out on<n>feedin' time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: C'mon, hurry! We gotta get the best<n>spot!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Look! Look how powerful<n>that crocodile
is! Big jaw goes<n>chomp!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, those teeth! I don't even want<n>to imagine
getting bit by those!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What about Windy? I've got a mean<n>bite too.

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text: It's so cute, munching away with that<n>big mouth!

text_block_list.name: Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know they stood up in the<n>water like that.
I'm starting to think<n>it's kinda cute!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! It's all about them—no fair!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My bite's just as powerful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we make our way around the<n>exhibits, Windy's
mood only gets<n>worse and worse. This could be
bad...

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text: Poor Goatson. No visitors today either,<n>huh.

text_block_list.name: Goatson
text_block_list.text: Maa...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...What's up with that? A goat's<n>takin' a walk.
choice_data_list: Some sort of petting event, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... If you have a moment, why<n>don't you play
with him? He's an<n>adorable fella, but no one pays
him<n>any attention.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hey you, c'mere for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: We do like this, and this, and then<n>pull...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nahahaha! Look! I braided his goatee!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Look at you, mopin' around<n>just 'cause ya
don't get any<n>attention. Well, I'm different!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch. I'm gonna pull a<n>huge prank, and
then everybody's<n>eyes will be on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Windy provokes the melancholy goat,<n>but in a way,
she almost seems to be<n>comforting him too. Maybe
she feels<n>a sense of kinship with the poor<n>creature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when it hits me: maybe this<n>could be a
chance to harness her<n>creativity—to prove that her
talents<n>can be used for so much more than<n>pranks.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaddya mean, I should prank<n>Goatson?
choice_data_list: I think Goatson wants some attention too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrm, you have a point... He might be a<n>good victim.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, prepare yourself, Goatson!<n>Windy's about
to show ya what a<n>prank's all about!

text_block_list.name: Goatson
text_block_list.text: M-maah?

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text:
Okay, where to next? Looks like the<n>giraffes and
rhinos are over there.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAAAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Goatson! Wonderin' where your<n>meal went? Well
guess what—Windy<n>ate it all!
choice_data_list: How dastardly! Wicked Windy strikes again!

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that girl—I only looked away for a<n>second! Sorry,
Goatson!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are they doing over there?!<n>Look at her
standing on top of that<n>cliff!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Did the goat get its food stolen?<n>That's so mean!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Haaahaha! Too bad for you, Goatson!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If only you were stronger, ya<n>could've taken it
back. Sucks to be<n>weak, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Goatson
text_block_list.text: Maa... Maahhh...

text_block_list.name: Goatson
text_block_list.text: MAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Visitor C
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The goat's running up the cliff!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text: But it's practically vertical! Is that<n>even possible?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wha? Y-you actually climbed up...<n>Ahem! Well, you
have some strong<n>legs!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You've earned a spot in<n>Windy's Warriors!
Here, have some<n>grass as a reward!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: You go, Goatson! Did Windy know<n>he'd do that?

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: That was fun! Do more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: More, you say? Wahaha! Guess I<n>have no choice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Next, you'll witness how strong<n>Windy is! Goatson,
you can show off<n>how amazing you are too!

text_block_list.name: Goatson
text_block_list.text: Maaa! Maaaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Woo! I feel like I'm on top of the<n>world!

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Goatson looks<n>thrilled to have
all the new company!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Smell ya later, Goatson! Don't let this<n>chance go to
waste, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We leave the zoo and hurry back to<n>the academy.
Along the way, I notice<n>Windy looking up at the sky
every<n>now and then.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...You know, that was a lot of people,<n>wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I was amazing. Needless to<n>say. Nothing
new there. But...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pranks, huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Illuminated by the setting sun, Windy<n>looks just a
bit more mature than<n>usual.
